CandleFeed.description: Dashboard chart: candles plus trade markers and open-position lines.
CandleFeed.title: CandleFeed

ChartMarker.description: A trade fill or decision stamped on the bar where it happened.
ChartMarker.title: ChartMarker

CheckOut.description: One input or output check result shown on a call card.
CheckOut.title: CheckOut

CostsOut.description: Estimated spend per feature for one month, against the cap.
CostsOut.title: CostsOut

IndicatorsOut.description:
The whole Indicators screen in one payload.

``frozen_*`` is set when the payload is pinned to a past decision
(``?at=<decision id>``): every value is computed from candles that were
closed at that moment.
IndicatorsOut.title: IndicatorsOut

LlmCallDetail.description:
Everything stored for one call: the exact request and response, the
checks, retries, cost and the decision it produced.
LlmCallDetail.title: LlmCallDetail

LlmCallListItem.description:
One call-history row; ``kind == "skipped"`` is a decision row where
the Rules pre-filter passed nothing to the model.
LlmCallListItem.title: LlmCallListItem

MarketSettings-Input.description:
Market-data and eligibility thresholds — all tunable, never literals
in logic. The shared ADX threshold is used by the reads, the regime,
Rules condition C6 and Insights.
MarketSettings-Input.title: MarketSettings

MarketSettings-Output.description:
Market-data and eligibility thresholds — all tunable, never literals
in logic. The shared ADX threshold is used by the reads, the regime,
Rules condition C6 and Insights.
MarketSettings-Output.title: MarketSettings

RiskSettings-Input.description: Every risk-gate threshold lives here, never as a literal in logic.
RiskSettings-Input.title: RiskSettings

RiskSettings-Output.description: Every risk-gate threshold lives here, never as a literal in logic.
RiskSettings-Output.title: RiskSettings

RulesSettings-Input.description:
Rules-decider thresholds — tunable without code changes; every Rules
decision stores the settings version it used.
RulesSettings-Input.title: RulesSettings

RulesSettings-Output.description:
Rules-decider thresholds — tunable without code changes; every Rules
decision stores the settings version it used.
RulesSettings-Output.title: RulesSettings

SessionOut.description:
The X-Local-Token for the served UI.

No CORS headers are sent, so other sites can call this but cannot read
the response.
SessionOut.title: SessionOut

Settings-Input.description:
The one validated JSON document stored in the settings table.

Unknown keys are dropped on load; new fields added later take their default.
Settings-Input.title: Settings

Settings-Output.description:
The one validated JSON document stored in the settings table.

Unknown keys are dropped on load; new fields added later take their default.
Settings-Output.title: Settings

get.description:
Newest-first activity log; ``before`` is the row id of the last item
from the previous page.

What Stop & flatten would close right now: count, estimated exit fees
and the live unrealised P&L.

Dashboard chart feed: stored closed candles, trade markers and the
open position's entry/stop/target lines.

Estimated model spend per feature for one month, against the cap.
``month`` is ``YYYY-MM`` on the Amsterdam clock (default: current).

delete.description:
Wipe every table except settings (API keys live outside the database),
then open a fresh paper account. The agent is paused afterwards.

schema.title: Response Delete All Data Api Data Delete

get.description: Newest-first decision history; ``before`` pages backwards in time.

One decision plus the raw stored call and prev/next ids for the
drawer's stepper.
Every stored decision (all accounts), newest first.
Every closed trade (all accounts), newest first.

The Indicators screen in one payload.

``at`` pins every value to a stored decision: the candles are sliced at
the decision's timestamp so the numbers match what the decider saw.
CSV of candles plus every indicator series for the window.

Call history plus, when ``skipped``, the cycles the pre-filter
decided not to send — merged newest-first.

Labelled calls as JSONL — verdict, the brief and the parsed output.
``outcome`` is null until the outcome worker lands in a later PR.
The whole call record as one JSON file.

post.description:
Re-send the stored request, optionally on another model or prompt
version. Replays count against the daily budget and pause at 80% of the
monthly cap.

put.description: Mark a call Correct or Wrong, with an optional note; null clears.

schema.title: Response List Markets Api Markets Get

post.description:
Start a new paper account; decisions, calls, verdicts and outcomes
stay tagged with the account they belonged to. Clears Killed too.

get.description:
Equity curve, BTC benchmark, drawdown, totals and per-pair stats for
the current account over ``start..end``. ``start`` defaults to the
account's creation ("Since start").

Every prompt version on disk with the model parameters from its header
(the Settings select).

schema.title: Response Get Prompts Api Prompts Get
